Number: 577

Summarize:
OpENer v2.3 / master branch up to commit 76b95cf is reported vulnerable in the TCP explicit-messaging path (RegisterSession -> SendRRData). A crafted EtherNet/IP SendRRData request can reach the Connection Manager instance services ForwardClose (0x4E), GetConnectionData (0x56), or SearchConnectionData (0x57) and trigger a stack-buffer-overflow read. The report attributes this to missing minimum request-body length validation in these handlers after Message Router path decoding: a long but syntactically acceptable padded EPath can consume the remaining CIP payload, leave request_data_size == 0, and the handlers still call GetUintFromMessage() / GetUdintFromMessage() on message_router_request->data. The reported result is an out-of-bounds read past the stack receive buffer, with stated impact of at least remote unauthenticated denial of service.

Reproduce:
Prerequisite: an affected OpENer target on TCP port 44818; the report says no ForwardOpen or special build options are required. Use the provided Python 3 PoC (host argument or OPENER_HOST, default 127.0.0.1). It opens a TCP connection, sends RegisterSession (encapsulation 0x0065) to obtain a session handle, then sends SendRRData (0x006F) with CPF item count 2, a null address item, and unconnected-data item 0x00B2 carrying a CIP request for one target service: forwardclose=0x4E, getconn=0x56, or searchconn=0x57. Build the CIP request as the service byte plus a path with path_size_words=235, Class 0x06, Instance 0x01, and Member ID segment 0x28 0x00 repeated 233 times, so no request body bytes remain after path decoding. Run one of the documented commands: `python3 poc.py forwardclose 192.168.153.128`, `python3 poc.py getconn 192.168.153.128`, or `python3 poc.py searchconn 192.168.153.128`. The script prints the target/service, lengths, session handle, and either a response hex dump or `response=timeout`. Expected result per the report: the selected Connection Manager handler performs a stack-buffer-overflow / out-of-bounds read past the stack receive buffer.

Payload:
